generic.Defined scope/population: Candidate local carriers and fronting partners able to issue an admitted policy in the territory.
generic.In-scope period: The partner selection window running to the programme inception timetable.
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Licence evidence, financial strength rating, capacity and tax handling recorded per candidate.
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Candidates assessed equal the shortlist recorded on the programme file.
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Licence certificates and rating evidence retained with the check date and source.
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Rejected candidates logged with the reason and the approver of the selection.
generic.Test population: All shortlisted local partners assessed for the territory placement.
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Selected partner recorded with licence evidence, rating and selection rationale.
generic.Exception handling path: Candidates failing due diligence escalated to the Underwriting Director / Manager.
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: No local partner selected without completed licence and financial-strength due diligence.
generic.Evidence location: Programme file in Microsoft 365 / SharePoint with the partner record on the policy system.

steps.title: Confirm the territory requires a locally admitted policy
sop: Check whether the class is compulsory locally or non-admitted cover is prohibited.
Record the legal basis including any premium tax rule driving local issuance.
Done when the legal basis for a local policy is recorded on the programme file.
verify: Re-check the recorded basis against the territory regulatory position.
Pass when the recorded legal basis matches the territory requirement.

steps.title: Shortlist candidate local carriers and fronting partners
sop: Identify candidate local carriers and fronting partners for the territory and class.
Record each candidate on the programme file with the source of the referral.
Done when the candidate shortlist is recorded on the programme file.
verify: Check the shortlist covers more than one viable candidate.
Pass when the shortlist records at least two assessable candidates.

steps.title: Check each candidate licence for the class and territory
sop: Obtain licence evidence for each candidate for the specific class in that territory.
Confirm the licence is current at the planned inception date.
Done when licence evidence is held for every shortlisted candidate.
verify: Re-check two licences against the local regulator register.
Pass when every candidate holds a current licence for the class.

steps.title: Assess financial strength, reputation and capacity
sop: Record the financial strength rating and local market reputation for each candidate.
Compare available capacity against the programme requirement.
Done when rating, reputation and capacity are recorded per candidate.
verify: Compare recorded ratings to the rating agency source.
Pass when every candidate carries a current rating and capacity assessment.

steps.title: Confirm issuance, evidence of cover and tax handling capability
sop: Confirm the partner can issue the required local wording and evidence of cover.
Confirm premium tax handling fits the programme timetable.
Done when issuance and tax capability are confirmed per candidate.
verify: Test the stated issuance timetable against the programme inception date.
Pass when the selected partner can issue inside the programme timetable.

steps.title: Record the selection rationale and rejected alternatives
sop: Write the selection rationale citing licence, rating, capacity and timetable.
Record the rejected alternatives with the reason for rejection.
Done when the rationale and rejections are recorded on the programme file.
verify: Check the rationale cites the due diligence evidence held.
Pass when the recorded rationale is supported by the retained evidence.

steps.title: Open the partner record on the programme file and policy system
sop: Open the partner record in the policy administration system for the programme.
Attach the licence, rating and approval evidence to the record.
Done when the partner record is open with its evidence attached.
verify: Open the partner record and check the attached evidence.
Pass when the partner record holds licence, rating and approval evidence.
